sections.title: Sharp Computational Bounds for Spectral Types of Schrödinger Operators
sections.abstract: The authors prove matching lower and upper limits on how many nested limiting procedures are needed to compute spectral sets of broad Schrödinger operators.
sections.claimed_result: A sharp hierarchy for computability of pure-point, absolutely continuous, and singular-continuous spectral sets.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Self-adjoint differential/Schrödinger operators with finite descriptions; explicit 1D lower bounds and broad multidimensional upper bounds.
sections.caveat: Computational model and finite-description assumptions are essential.

sections.title: Quantitative Parisi formulas and fluctuations in the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model
sections.abstract: Quantitative Parisi formulas and fluctuation bounds at zero external field, including polynomial orders for partition-function and ground-state variances.
sections.claimed_result: Variance orders between N^(4/15) and N^(7/15), plus finite-size bias and tail bounds.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model at zero external field, positive and zero temperature.
sections.caveat: The abstract reports a range rather than a single sharp exponent.

sections.title: Non-uniqueness for the Complex Ginzburg-Landau Equation
sections.abstract: A computer-assisted proof shows singularities in a 3D cubic complex Ginzburg-Landau equation can produce non-unique post-blowup solutions.
sections.claimed_result: An unstable eigenvalue around a forward self-similar profile implies non-uniqueness for selected parameters.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Three-dimensional cubic complex Ginzburg-Landau equation; parameter-specific computer-assisted result.
sections.caveat: It is not a Navier–Stokes non-uniqueness theorem.

sections.title: Silver Rate Is (Almost) Optimal for Gradient Descent Acceleration
sections.abstract: Lower bounds show predetermined nonnegative step-size schedules cannot asymptotically beat silver-schedule polynomial exponents.
sections.claimed_result: Near-matching finite-horizon and anytime lower bounds determine optimal exponents with prior upper bounds.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Smooth convex optimization with predetermined nonnegative step sizes.
sections.caveat: The result concerns predetermined schedules and includes lower-order exponent terms.

sections.title: Sharp Fractional Riesz Estimates on the Hypercube
sections.abstract: Sharp fractional Riesz estimates on the discrete hypercube, with higher-order analogues and semigroup applications.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Uniform finite hypercube with Walsh gradient and Laplacian.
sections.caveat: The abstract only establishes the stated discrete setting and range.

sections.title: Pathwise Global-in-Time Existence for the generalised KPZ Equation in the Full Subcritical Regime
sections.abstract: A pathwise proof of global-in-time well-posedness for generalized KPZ throughout the full subcritical regime, including L-infinity initial data.
sections.claimed_result: Global-in-time existence via deterministic-profile expansion and an integrating factor.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Generalized KPZ in the subcritical regime with merely L-infinity initial data.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not specify the full generalized-equation parameterization.

sections.title: The border Waring rank of x_1...x_n is 2^(n-1)
sections.abstract: The exact border Waring rank of the squarefree monomial x_1...x_n is proved over characteristic-zero fields.
sections.claimed_result: Border Waring rank exactly 2^(n-1), with a lower bound from a determinant-tensor Koszul flattening.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Characteristic-zero fields and symmetric tensor/Waring-rank setting.
sections.caveat: Technical hypotheses of the flattening argument require full-paper checking.

sections.title: Abelian Cayley High-Dimensional Expanders with Polylogarithmic Degree
sections.abstract: Explicit Cayley complexes over F_2^n with strong local spectral expansion and favorable degree bounds.
sections.claimed_result: Two-dimensional simple complexes with polynomial degree and fixed-lambda spectral control, plus weighted fixed-dimensional families of degree Theta_d(n).
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Cayley complexes over F_2^n; higher-dimensional construction is weighted.
sections.caveat: The higher-dimensional guarantee is weighted and differs from the simple-complex claim.
